subject: general
question: On 15 April 2025, in which city of India STREE Summit 2025 on Women's Safety and Empowerment was held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The STREE Summit 2025 was held in **Hyderabad**, a city known for its progressive initiatives towards women's empowerment.
 
• It took place on **15 April 2025**, focusing on **women's safety and empowerment** as the central theme.
 
• The summit aimed at bringing together policymakers, activists, and organizations to deliberate on effective solutions for **gender equality**.
 
• Hyderabad, the capital of Telangana, has been at the forefront of implementing innovative programs for women’s safety, such as the **SHE Teams initiative**.
 
• Government officials, NGOs, and representatives from multiple states participated to exchange ideas on **sustainable empowerment models**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SHE Teams Initiative:**

 
 
• Launched in **Telangana**, SHE Teams focus on ensuring women’s safety in public spaces through surveillance and quick response mechanisms.
 
• These teams work on complaints related to eve-teasing, harassment, and stalking, promoting a safer environment for women.
 
 
 
• **One Stop Centres (OSC):**
 
 
• Initiated under the **Ministry of Women and Child Development**, OSCs provide support to women affected by violence.
 
• These centers offer integrated services such as police assistance, legal aid, medical care, and counseling.
 
 
 
• **Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao:**
 
 
• A flagship scheme of the Indian government aimed at **improving the sex ratio** and ensuring education for the girl child.
 
• It emphasizes the need to address gender-biased practices and empower girls through education and skill development.
 
 
 
• **Gender Equality Index:**
 
 
• An index used globally to measure the progress of nations towards achieving gender parity in areas such as education, health, and economic participation.
 
• India has been undertaking consistent efforts to improve its standing through targeted initiatives for women.
 
 
 
• **Women’s Safety Audit:**
 
 
• It is a tool used to identify unsafe areas and suggest measures to enhance women’s safety in urban and rural settings.
 
• Hyderabad is among the cities actively using this approach to improve public infrastructure and surveillance systems.
